# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow the canonical repository instructions in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).

That file is the single source of truth for:

- Project overview and tech stack
- Hexagonal architecture rules and module layout
- Critical rules every contributor and AI agent must follow (multi-tenant isolation, error handling, type usage, layer boundaries, API conventions, SQL conventions, lint compliance, import organization, Git conventions, documentation updates)
- Available agents and reference documentation

Do not duplicate rules here. When you need to update agent guidance, edit `AGENTS.md`.
